t: The $(item)Inventory Checker$() emits a $(thing)redstone signal$() if the inventory behind it has more than a certain number of items in a specified slot. Both the slot and the item can be defined in the GUI, alongside an optional $(thing)Item Tag$(), and whether to ignore or match the damage of the specified item. These can also be left blank to match any item that goes in the slot.
$(item)物品检查器$()会在其后方的容器中，指定槽位内的物品数量超过某个值时发出$(thing)红石信号$()。你可以在 GUI 中定义槽位和物品，并可选填$(thing)物品标签$()，以及指定是忽略还是匹配该物品的耐久值。这些条件也都可以留空，以匹配放入该槽位的任意物品。
The GUI selects the slot, stack, optional item tag, damage mode, and threshold. Leave item or tag matching empty when any valid item in that slot should count.
GUI界面可选择插槽、物品堆叠、可选物品标签、伤害模式及阈值。当该插槽中任意有效物品均应被计入时，请留空物品或标签匹配项。
Remember, slot counts start at zero!
记住，槽位计数从零开始！
